description: Election Commission - W. B. W. M. R. I. D. Aluwihara was Elected as the Member of the Warakapola P.S., D. M. L. P. B. Mirihella was Elected as the Member of the Kegalle U.C., R. D. Dharmarathna was Elected as the Member of the Matale M.C.
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Warakapola Pradeshiya Sabha, Kegalle Urban Council, and Matale Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, including declarations of selected members to fill vacancies caused by resignations or party membership cessation, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) as it concerns electoral matters and local authority member appointments.
